frozen_before: Task 1; no measured run of this plan has happened
rule: Values are the plan's agent-selected targets, copied unchanged. A miss stays a miss: no target, case or workload changes after a result; a change needs a recorded successor disposition.

store.persistence: appendonly yes, appendfsync everysec, periodic RDB

k2.loss_scope: tested crashes with the volume intact; not hardware, power or volume loss

forecast_usd.prices: summarizer route registry, USD 0.50 input and 2.50 output per million tokens (2026-11-16)
forecast_usd.limit: a zero-paid workload forecast, not a measured charge or a universal bound; reprice before any paid release

recovery.location: .optimus/memory-recovery/ in the one confirmed trusted worktree per project
recovery.contents: active payloads only, plus registry, payload-free lifecycle and exclusion metadata and an authenticated manifest

paid_release_proposals.rule: proposals only; each needs its own operator release with route, prices, caps and forecast bound first. Counts are physical provider attempts.

M3-ZED-SWITCH.condition: only with a qualified and released second route (D6)
